sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION (Hindi-English code-mixed). Fictional client c04 (Vikram I.), session 2026-11-12. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Vikram ji, aaj aap thake hue lag rahe ho. Kya hua?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Layoff announce ho gaya. Mera naam list mein hai.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Oh. I'm so sorry. Kab pata chala?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Monday ko. Teen mahine ki salary denge.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Yeh bahut bada jhatka hai. Aap kaise handle kar rahe ho?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Har raat pee raha hoon. Paanch, chhe peg. Kal raat gaadi bhi chala ke ghar aaya.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Pee ke gaadi chalayi?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Haan. Pata hai galat hai.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: I'm glad you told me. Yeh aapki aur doosron ki safety ka sawaal hai. Kya hum agree kar sakte hain ki pee ke gaadi nahi chalayenge, cab lenge?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Haan. Theek hai.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Aur mann mein kya chal raha hai?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Kabhi kabhi lagta hai sab khatam kar doon. Itne saal kaam kiya, aur ab kuch nahi.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Jab aap kehte ho sab khatam kar doon, kya aap apni jaan lene ke baare mein soch rahe ho?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Plan nahi hai. Bas thought aata hai, raat ko, peene ke baad.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Thank you for being honest. Main chahti hoon ki hum abhi ek safety plan banayein. Raat ko yeh thought aaye toh aap kya karoge, kisko call karoge?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Mera bhai. Rajiv ko call kar sakta hoon.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Achha. Aur aap psychiatry consult ke liye open ho? Sleep aur drinking dono ke liye help mil sakti hai.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Haan, try kar sakta hoon.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Main team se bolti hoon ki is hafte psychiatry appointment book karein. WhatsApp pe Hindi mein details bhejenge.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Theek hai. Wife ko mat batana abhi.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Main aapki permission ke bina unse contact nahi karungi. Kal ek chhota call karein, check-in ke liye?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Haan, shaam ko.
